items.source: 204 No Content: For PUT, PATCH, and DELETE requests when the configuration is set to not return response bodies for resource updates (RepositoryRestConfiguration.setReturnBodyOnUpdate(…)). If the configuration value is set to include responses for PUT, 200 OK is returned for updates, and 201 Created is returned for resource created through PUT.
items.translation: 204 无内容：当配置设置为不返回资源更新的响应体时（RepositoryRestConfiguration.setReturnBodyOnUpdate(…)），针对 PUT、PATCH 和 DELETE 请求会返回此状态码。 如果配置值设置为包含响应，则对更新操作返回 200 OK，而对通过 PUT 创建的资源返回 201 Created。

items.source: If the configuration values (RepositoryRestConfiguration.returnBodyOnUpdate(…) and RepositoryRestConfiguration.returnBodyCreate(…)) are explicitly set to null — which they are by default --, the presence of the HTTP Accept header is used to determine the response code. Read more on this in the detailed description of collection and item resources.
items.translation: 如果配置值（RepositoryRestConfiguration.returnBodyOnUpdate(…) 和 RepositoryRestConfiguration.returnBodyCreate(…)）被显式设置为 null——这也就是它们的默认值——那么将使用 HTTP Accept 头的存在与否来确定响应代码。 有关此内容的更多详细信息，请参阅集合资源和项目资源的详细描述。

items.source: Item resources generally support GET, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE, unless explicit configuration prevents that (see “The Association Resource” for details).
items.translation: 项目资源通常支持 `GET`、`PUT`、`PATCH` 和 `DELETE`，除非显式配置阻止了这些操作（详见"关联资源"以获取详细信息）。

items.source: The PUT method replaces the state of the target resource with the supplied request body. By default, whether the response contains a body is controlled by the Accept header sent with the request. If the request header is present, a response body and a status code of 200 OK is returned. If no header is present, the response body is empty and a successful request returns a status of 204 No Content. This behavior can be overridden by configuring RepositoryRestConfiguration.setReturnBodyOnUpdate(…) accordingly.
items.translation:
`PUT` 方法将目标资源的状态替换为请求体中提供的数据。  
默认情况下，响应是否包含正文由随请求发送的 `Accept` 头控制。  
如果存在该请求头，则返回响应正文和状态码 `200 OK`。  
如果不存在该请求头，则响应正文为空，成功请求将返回状态码 `204 No Content`。  
可以通过相应配置 `RepositoryRestConfiguration.setReturnBodyOnUpdate(…)` 来覆盖此行为。

items.source: The DELETE method deletes the resource exposed. By default, whether the response contains a body is controlled by the Accept header sent with the request. If the request header is present, a response body and a status code of 200 OK is returned. If no header is present, the response body is empty and a successful request returns a status of 204 No Content. This behavior can be overridden by configuring RepositoryRestConfiguration.setReturnBodyOnDelete(…) accordingly.
items.translation:
`DELETE` 方法用于删除所暴露的资源。  
默认情况下，响应是否包含正文由请求中发送的 `Accept` 头控制。  
如果存在该请求头，则返回响应正文以及状态码 `200 OK`。  
如果不存在该头，则响应正文为空，成功请求将返回状态码 `204 No Content`。  
可以通过相应配置 `RepositoryRestConfiguration.setReturnBodyOnDelete(…)` 来覆盖此行为。

items.source: The POST method creates a new entity from the given request body. By default, whether the response contains a body is controlled by the Accept header sent with the request. If one is sent, a response body is created. If not, the response body is empty and a representation of the resource created can be obtained by following link contained in the Location response header. This behavior can be overridden by configuring RepositoryRestConfiguration.setReturnBodyOnCreate(…) accordingly.
items.translation:
`POST` 方法根据给定的请求体创建新实体。  
默认情况下，响应是否包含正文由随请求发送的 `Accept` 头控制。  
如果发送了该头，则创建响应正文；否则，响应正文为空，可通过遵循 `Location` 响应头中包含的链接来获取所创建资源的表示形式。  
此行为可以通过相应配置 `RepositoryRestConfiguration.setReturnBodyOnCreate(…)` 进行覆盖。

items.source: By default, the HTTP methods to interact with these resources map to the according methods of CrudRepository. Read more on that in the sections on collection resources and item resources.
items.translation: 默认情况下，与这些资源交互的 HTTP 方法会映射到CrudRepository的相应方法。有关该主题的更多信息，请参阅集合资源和项资源部分。

items.source: 201 Created: For POST and PUT requests that create new resources.
items.translation: 201 Created：表示通过 POST 和 PUT 请求成功创建了新资源。

items.source: Collections resources support both GET and POST. All other HTTP methods cause a 405 Method Not Allowed.
items.translation: 集合资源同时支持GET和POST。所有其他HTTP方法将导致返回405 Method Not Allowed错误。

items.source: 405 Method Not Allowed: If the findAll(…) methods were not exported (through @RestResource(exported = false)) or are not present in the repository.
items.translation: 405 方法不允许：如果未导出 findAll(…) 方法（通过 @RestResource(exported = false)）或仓库中不存在这些方法。

items.source: 405 Method Not Allowed: If the save(…) methods were not exported (through @RestResource(exported = false)) or are not present in the repository at all.
items.translation: 405 方法不允许：如果未导出save(…)方法（通过@RestResource(exported = false)）或仓库中根本不存在该方法。

items.source: 405 Method Not Allowed: If the findOne(…) methods were not exported (through @RestResource(exported = false)) or are not present in the repository.
items.translation: 405 方法不允许：如果 findOne(…) 方法未导出（通过 @RestResource(exported = false)）或不在仓库中存在。

items.source: 405 Method Not Allowed: If the save(…) methods were not exported (through @RestResource(exported = false)) or is not present in the repository at all.
items.translation: 405 方法不允许：如果未导出 save(…) 方法（通过 @RestResource(exported = false)）或该仓库中根本不存在此方法。

items.source: 405 Method Not Allowed: If the save(…) methods were not exported (through @RestResource(exported = false)) or are not present in the repository.
items.translation: 405 方法不允许：如果未导出（通过 @RestResource(exported = false)）save(…) 方法，或者该仓库中不存在这些方法。

items.source: 405 Method Not Allowed: If the delete(…) methods were not exported (through @RestResource(exported = false)) or are not present in the repository.
items.translation: 405 方法不允许：如果未导出（通过 @RestResource(exported = false)）delete(…) 方法，或者这些方法在仓库中不存在。

items.source: For this repository, Spring Data REST exposes a collection resource at /orders. The path is derived from the uncapitalized, pluralized, simple class name of the domain class being managed. It also exposes an item resource for each of the items managed by the repository under the URI template /orders/{id}.
items.translation: 在此仓库中，Spring Data REST 在路径 `/orders` 处暴露集合资源。该路径是根据所管理的域类的未大写、复数化、简单类名推导得出的。此外，它还在 URI 模板 `/orders/{id}` 下为存储库管理的每个项目暴露一个项目资源。

items.source: Which HTTP resources are exposed for a certain repository is mostly driven by the structure of the repository. In other words, the resource exposure will follow which methods you have exposed on the repository. If you extend CrudRepository you usually expose all methods required to expose all HTTP resources we can register by default. Each of the resources listed below will define which of the methods need to be present so that a particular HTTP method can be exposed for each of the resources. That means, that repositories that are not exposing those methods — either by not declaring them at all or explicitly using @RestResource(exported = false) — won’t expose those HTTP methods on those resources.
items.translation: 哪些 HTTP 资源对某个仓库可见，主要取决于该仓库的结构。换句话说，资源暴露将遵循您在仓库上公开的方法。如果您扩展了 CrudRepository，通常会暴露所有默认可注册的 HTTP 资源所需的方法。下面列出的每种资源都将定义需要存在哪些方法，以便为每种资源暴露特定的 HTTP 方法。这意味着，如果仓库未公开这些方法——无论是完全不声明它们，还是显式使用 @RestResource(exported = false)——那么这些仓库就不会在这些资源上暴露相应的 HTTP 方法。

items.source: 200 OK: For plain GET requests.
items.translation: 200 OK：针对普通 GET 请求。

items.source: A core principle of HATEOAS is that resources should be discoverable through the publication of links that point to the available resources. There are a few competing de-facto standards of how to represent links in JSON. By default, Spring Data REST uses HAL to render responses. HAL defines the links to be contained in a property of the returned document.
items.translation: HATEOAS 的核心原则是，资源应通过发布指向可用资源的链接来实现可发现性。在 JSON 中表示链接方面存在几种相互竞争的既定事实标准。默认情况下，Spring Data REST 使用 HAL 来渲染响应。HAL 定义这些链接应包含在返回文档的属性中。

items.translation: search：如果底层仓库暴露了查询方法，则会公开一个搜索资源。

items.source: For every association of the domain type, we expose links named after the association property. You can customize this behavior by using @RestResource on the property. The related resources are of the association resource type.
items.translation: 对于每种域类型关联，我们都会暴露以关联属性命名的链接。您可以通过在属性上使用 `@RestResource` 来自定义此行为。相关资源属于关联资源类型。

items.translation: `PATCH` 方法与 `PUT` 方法类似，但仅部分更新资源的状态。

items.translation: 对于仓库中声明的每个查询方法，我们都暴露一个查询方法资源。如果该资源支持分页，则指向它的 URI 是一个包含分页参数的 URI 模板。

items.source: The HEAD method returns whether the search resource is available. A 404 return code indicates no query method resources are available.
items.translation: `HEAD` 方法返回搜索资源是否可用。返回代码 404 表示没有可用的查询方法资源。

items.source: As the query method resource is a read-only resource, it supports GET only.
items.translation: 由于查询方法资源是只读资源，因此仅支持GET。

items.source: Resource discovery starts at the top level of the application. By issuing a request to the root URL under which the Spring Data REST application is deployed, the client can extract, from the returned JSON object, a set of links that represent the next level of resources that are available to the client.
items.translation: 资源发现从应用程序的顶层开始。通过向部署 Spring Data REST 应用程序的根 URL 发出请求，客户端可以从返回的 JSON 对象中提取一组链接，这些链接代表了可供客户端访问的下一级资源。
